title: Momoi Airi — To You Who Wants To Be An Idol〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: To You Who Wants To Be An Idol（4★）

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: <Now, onto our next segment!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hmm... Some of these segues between segments are really good, but others are kinda bad.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's never that easy, is it? You have to find the right thing to say in a limited amount of time on the spot.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess that goes under work in progress...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (By themselves, Shizuku and Minori do great during segments, and our viewers seem to really like that.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They even throw in their own quips and comebacks from time to time while they're talking.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But that's something we have to take advantage of since livestreaming is what we've decided to do!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And...!
There! That's every stream from this past week!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All that's left is to fix whatever's still a work in progress...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. The notebook of talking points that I made while I was still in QT helps so much for this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's see...
I think I left it on this shelf... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, having stored away my oldest stuff first might've been a mistake. It's such a pain to find stuff from way back when now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's not like these notebooks are separated into different categories either. Some even have stuff about singing, dancing and whatever else all mixed together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it'd be great to have all this digitized, but that would take forever too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At least for now, I can write what's actually in these things on each of their covers...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa! They're all pictures of idols and costumes that I drew when I was little!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I knew I still had them somewhere, but I guess you ended up being stuck between these notebooks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Talk about a blast from the past.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Idols sure are amazing...
Singing, dancing, making all those people smile...

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: They even do all those talk shows! I bet it's a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line:
You've been watching this girl a lot lately.
Do you really like her that much?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like just seeing her makes me happy. I can't help but start smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: That means she's just like you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't help but start smiling whenever I see you!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Maybe I really can be an idol!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: I bet I could get up on a big stage like her and sing and dance and make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Alright then...!
I'm going to become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A lot's happened since then, but here I am. Airi the idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I would love to see the look on little me's face when she saw that I'm an idol...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mhm... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? It's already past midnight...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd better quit while I'm ahead. Staying up any later is gonna affect the way I practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Did my phone flash just now...?
Hm? It doesn't look like anyone sent me anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, where's my alarm...? Good, it's all set. Now then, good night...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Is this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did I play Untitled by accident while setting my alarm?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(But it's so quiet...
I don't see Miku or the others anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I see a light over there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is this thing? It's too small for a stage light and it's perfectly round...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa! Now what...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Where am I...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What in the world is going on here?! I was in SEKAI just now and...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, this looks like a museum or something...! I need to keep my voice down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, now's not the time for that. Seriously, what is this place...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel like I've seen all these costumes and idol merch somewhere before too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Am I dreaming?
But I'm completely conscious...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Hey, there's a kid here!
I'll ask them and see if they know anything.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh, hi. I need some...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, this is a museum!
You have to be quiet!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: R-Right, sorry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Seriously, what's going on here?!
She looks just like me from when I was little!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, hey... Mind if I ask what your name is?

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line:
My name? I'm Airi!
What's your name?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wh-What a coincidence...?!
My name's Airi too.

rows.Speaker: Little Airi
rows.Line: Really?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it is... Haha...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (S-Seriously, what in the world is going on here?!)
